newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan power demand could reach record in summer.
newsitem.headline: Japan power demand could reach record in summer.

text.p: Peak electricity demand at Japan's 10 private power utilities could reach a record high this summer if temperatures are normal for the period, an industry body said on Monday.
Peak demand could hit 173.6 million kw if temperatures are about normal and 185.5 million kilowatts (kw) if the mercury rises above normal levels, the Federation of Electric Power Companies said.
The current record of 171.1 million kw was marked on August 25, 1995, the federation said.
The Meteorological Agency, however, has said that there is a strong chance that temperatures this summer will be lower than average.
"It looks like temperatures this summer will be lower than last year," an agency spokesman said.
Japan's 10 power utilities together are capable of supplying about 191.4 million kw of electricity. --Tokyo Energy Desk +81-3-5473-3706
